      "id": "d_artifact",
      "term": "Artifact",
      "verbatim_text": "An immutable blob of data; primarily refers to software, but SLSA can be used for any artifact.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Artifact | An immutable",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },

      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Attestation | An authenticated",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_source",
      "term": "Source",
      "verbatim_text": "Artifact that was directly authored or reviewed by persons, without modification. It is the beginning of the supply chain; we do not trace the provenance back any further.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Source | Artifact that was",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_build_sc",
      "term": "Build",
      "verbatim_text": "Process that transforms a set of input artifacts into a set of output artifacts. The inputs may be sources, dependencies, or ephemeral build outputs.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| [Build] | Process that transforms",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_package",
      "term": "Package",
      "verbatim_text": "Artifact that is \"published\" for use by others. In the model, it is always the output of a build process, though that build process can be a no-op.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| [Package] | Artifact that is \"published\"",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_dependency",
      "term": "Dependency",
      "verbatim_text": "Artifact that is an input to a build process but that is not a source. In the model, it is always a package.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Dependency | Artifact that is an input",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_producer",
      "term": "Producer",
      "verbatim_text": "A party who creates software and provides it to others. Producers are often also consumers.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Producer | A party who creates",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_verifier",
      "term": "Verifier",
      "verbatim_text": "A party who inspect an artifact's provenance to determine the artifact's authenticity.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Verifier | A party who inspect",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_consumer",
      "term": "Consumer",
      "verbatim_text": "A party who uses software provided by a producer. The consumer may verify provenance for software they consume or delegate that responsibility to a separate verifier.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Consumer | A party who uses",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_infra_provider",
      "term": "Infrastructure provider",
      "verbatim_text": "A party who provides software or services to other roles.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Infrastructure provider | A party who provides",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_platform",
      "term": "Platform",
      "verbatim_text": "System that allows tenants to run builds. Technically, it is the transitive closure of software and services that must be trusted to faithfully execute the build. It includes software, hardware, people, and organizations.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Platform | System that allows",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_admin",
      "term": "Admin",
      "verbatim_text": "A privileged user with administrative access to the platform, potentially allowing them to tamper with builds or the control plane.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Admin | A privileged",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_tenant",
      "term": "Tenant",
      "verbatim_text": "An untrusted user that builds an artifact on the platform. The tenant defines the build steps and external parameters.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Tenant | An untrusted",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_control_plane",
      "term": "Control plane",
      "verbatim_text": "Build platform component that orchestrates each independent build execution and produces provenance. The control plane is managed by an admin and trusted to be outside the tenant's control.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Control plane | Build platform",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "d_build_model",
      "term": "Build",
      "verbatim_text": "Process that converts input sources and dependencies into output artifacts, defined by the tenant and executed within a single build environment on a platform.",
      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Build | Process that converts",

      "normative_status": "standard",
      "as_of_date": null,
      "anchor": "| Steps | The set",
      "location": "slsa-specification-v1-0#c0016"
    }
